units.source_text: 皇太子把柏木的话听在心里，后来便央桐壶女御去向三公主索取，三公主立刻把那小猫送了过来。

en.t: The Crown Prince took Kashiwagi's words to heart, and later asked the Kiritsubo Consort to request the cat from the Third Princess, who immediately sent the kitten over.

units.source_text: 皇太子身边的侍女看了，人人赞叹，都说这只猫漂亮极了！

en.t: When the ladies-in-waiting around the Crown Prince saw it, they all admired it and said the cat was extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 柏木卫门督前日察看皇太子神色，预料他是要去向三公主索取的，便在几天之后又来访问。

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Gate Guards, had observed the Crown Prince's expression the other day and guessed that he would ask the Third Princess for it, so he came to visit again a few days later.

units.source_text: 柏木从儿童时代起，就受朱雀院特别怜爱，常常在他身边侍候。

en.t: Since childhood, Kashiwagi had been especially cherished by the retired Emperor Suzaku and had often attended at his side.

units.source_text: 朱雀院入山修道以后，他又来亲近这位皇太子，处处用心照料。

en.t: After the retired Emperor Suzaku entered the mountains to practice religion, Kashiwagi drew close to this Crown Prince as well and took attentive care of him in every way.

units.source_text: 这一天他来访问，以教琴为借口，乘便问道：“这里猫真多啊，我在六条院窥见的是哪一只呢？”

en.t: On this day he came to visit, using a koto lesson as his excuse, and took the opportunity to ask, "There are so many cats here. Which one was it that I glimpsed at Rokujo-in?"

units.source_text: 他四处寻找，终于看到了那只中国猫。

en.t: He looked all around and finally spotted the Chinese cat.

units.source_text: 他很爱这只猫，便去抚摸它。

en.t: He was very fond of the cat, so he went over and stroked it.

units.source_text: 皇太子说道：“这只猫的确很可爱。

en.t: The Crown Prince said, "This cat certainly is very charming.

units.source_text: 大概还没有养驯，所以见了没看惯的人就怕生。

en.t: It probably has not been fully tamed yet, so it is shy when it sees people it is not used to.

units.source_text: 我这里的猫并不比它坏呢。”

en.t: The cats I have here are not inferior to it, though."

units.source_text: 柏木答道：“猫这种东西，大都不大会辨别陌生人和熟人。

en.t: Kashiwagi replied, "Cats, as creatures, usually do not distinguish very well between strangers and familiar people.

units.source_text: 不过聪明的猫，当然也很灵敏。”

en.t: But a clever cat is naturally very sensitive too."

units.source_text: 后来他就要求：“这里既然有许多好猫，请把这只猫暂时借给我吧。”

en.t: After that he made his request: "Since there are so many fine cats here, please lend me this one for a while."

units.source_text: 他自己心中也觉得这要求太冒昧了。

en.t: In his own heart, he too felt that this request was far too presumptuous.
